Sub-assistant 2026 Place of work St. Gallen
• Your tasks and perspectives To complete the practical year at HOCH Health Ostschweiz, we offer you sub-assistant positions as a sub-assistant in the specialist areas below. Some of our clinics also offer internships before the practical year in the form of internships: Department Available period Department of Internal Medicine (do not offer internships) Applications for the Department of Internal Medicine St.Gallen are accepted via the following link. Clinic for Surgery October to mid-November Clinic for Orthopedics and Traumatology (does not offer internships) occupied Clinic for Thoracic Surgery occupied Clinic for Dermatology, Venereology and Allergology (does not offer internships) July to August (minimum duration: two months) (start only possible on the first of the month) Clinic for Neurology September (1 month / no internships) (minimum duration: two months) Clinic for Neurosurgery June (1 Month) October (1 month) (Start only possible on the first of the month) Clinic for Radiation Oncology occupied Clinic for Radiology and Nuclear Medicine (Does not offer internships) June (1 month) November (1 month) (Start only possible on the first of the month) Clinic for Plastic Surgery and Hand Surgery (Does not offer internships) occupied (Starts only on the first of the month and only possible for entire months) Clinic for Urology (Does not offer internships) May to September (minimum deployment period: two months) (Planning begins in this department 12 months. before the start of employment) Clinic for anesthesiology, rescue and pain medicine (does not offer internships) occupied (duration of employment: two months) (start only possible on the first of the month) ENT clinic occupied eye clinic <td style="text-align:c
